*metavect.txt*  MetaVect filetype support

Filetype
--------
Files ending in .mv, .mvec, or .mvct are detected as MetaVect.

Syntax
------
The syntax file highlights core keywords, primitive types, numbers, strings,
operators, and line/block comments. The editor syntax is intentionally a
best-effort mirror of the lexer; the compiler lexer remains authoritative.

Indentation
-----------
Automatic indentation is enabled. This scaffold does not yet implement
syntax-aware indentation or formatting.

Install
-------
Add the extern/Vim directory to your Vim runtime path.
